# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 4, Poland-Lithuania Regional Line (1360-1580, oe_plc_). Generated by gen_poland_lithuania.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Lightweight regional fallback monthly pulse for Poland-Lithuania line (slot 49).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 49 has already run this month, oe_plc_ran_m == oe_plc_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Keeps the line alive if BYZ falls or before slot 49 is registered in gen_mainline_lock.py.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_plc_fallback_pulse } }

oe_plc_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1337
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { global_var:oe_plc_ran_m ?= oe_plc_m_now }
        OR = {
            oe_plc_human_fallback_eligible = yes
            tag = POL
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:POL } tag = LIT }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:POL } NOT = { country_exists = c:LIT } tag = PLC }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_plc_monthly = yes
    }
}
